title: cota monantha
intro: Cota monantha, commonly known as the Moroccan chamomile, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as soothing anxiety and promoting relaxation, due to its sedative and calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Cota monantha include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of insomnia, restlessness, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and essential oils, particularly the sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal value.
